children: Crane agreed to acquire the U.S. pump business from First Reserve-backed Trillium Flow Technologies for about $240 million.
Acquisition price ~ $240 million, ~14.6x estimated 2026 adjusted EBITDA.
Acquired brands include Floway, Wemco, Roto-Jet and WSP—focused on municipal water and wastewater.
Business expects full-year revenue of approximately $115 million.
Deal should expand Process Flow Technologies, add large installed base and recurring aftermarket demand.
Transaction expected to close in the fourth quarter, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Crane to buy Trillium's U.S. pump business for $240M, adds $115M revenue and aftermarket base
